scope: German offshore generation and offshore substation / transmission public-data feasibility

sources.title: Marktstammdatenregister public data export
sources.coverage: Public registry metadata for units and market actors, including CSV export, full download, and web service access.

sources.title: SMARD user manual
sources.coverage: Realized offshore wind generation is covered at German control-zone level; offshore wind is shown as measured coverage in 50Hertz and TenneT zones, not by individual wind farm or OSS.

sources.title: Bundesnetzagentur offshore wind tender hub
sources.coverage: Project award metadata and tender outcomes for German offshore wind.

wind_farm_generation.reason: Public German sources clearly provide registry metadata and offshore generation by control zone, but not a stable nationwide wind-farm-level generation feed.

individual_oss_transmission.reason: No clear public API or recurring dataset was found for individual offshore substation transmission or OSS load/flow telemetry.
